posts.title: 全线 Pro / Business Premium 用量翻倍
posts.summary: Tibo 宣布第 25 天：所有 Pro 100/200/500 档位以及 Business Premium 的用量上限翻倍，即日起生效；不会削减 Pro 200 的用量，Work 与 Codex 保持不变；dots 扩展额度暂时继续，且与默认用量分开计算；并会继续推出更好模型与效率改进以提升有效用量。
posts.originalText:
Day 25/

We are doubling all usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today.

We heard your kind feedback and won’t be reducing usage limits for Pro 200, so your Work and Codex usage will stay the same. We’re also going to continue offering extended limits for dots for now, and usage of your dot will still continue to be separate from your default usage.

And we'll of course also keep shipping better models and other efficiency improvements that increase your effective usage over time.
posts.titleEn: Usage limits doubled for Pro and Business Premium
posts.summaryEn: Day 25: usage limits doubled for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today; Pro 200 Work and Codex limits stay the same (no reduction); extended dots limits continue for now and remain separate from default usage; better models and efficiency improvements will keep raising effective usage.

posts.title: 像发短信一样给你的 dot 发消息
posts.summary: Tibo 宣布第 24 天：可以像给任何人发短信一样给你的 dot 发消息，方便分享/转发、留语音备忘，或用「Hey Siri, text Iggy to …」这类方式把任务交给它。引用的 ChatGPT 帖称应大家要求现已支持给 dot 发短信，可用文字、照片或语音备忘布置任务或盯着事情，它会主动发短信带回更新；经 iMessage 或 RCS 安全发送（可见正文在「只有你」处截断）。
posts.originalText: Day 24/ Text your dot just like anyone else. Makes it super easy to share/forward things, leave it voice notes or you can even go creative with "Hey Siri, text Iggy to <INSERT WILD REQUEST>" and sit back and relax.
posts.quotedText:
By popular request, you can now text your dot.

Give it a task to take off your plate or something to keep an eye on, using text, photos, or even voice notes. It will text you proactively with relevant updates.

Safe, secure texting via iMessage or RCS. You’re the only one who
posts.titleEn: Text your dot just like anyone else
posts.summaryEn: Day 24: text your dot like anyone else — easy to share/forward, leave voice notes, or Siri-hand off wild requests. Quoted ChatGPT post: by popular request you can text your dot with tasks or watch items via text, photos, or voice notes; it texts you proactively; safe via iMessage or RCS (visible text truncates at “You’re the only one who”).

posts.title: Terra 回来了：写作、个性与细腻理解更强，用量翻倍

posts.originalText:
Day 22/ Terra is back! 

Our first model that is significantly better at writing,  personality and nuanced understanding of requests.

Packs a punch across the board, very good at computer use, and gives 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions.

GPT-6.1 Terra: delivering fast and capable computer use at a lower price.

GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. https://t.co/8JTN1yonmV

posts.title: API 支持 12 小时缓存，Codex 和 Work 永久保留缓存
posts.summary: 现在可以在 API 中把缓存保留 12 小时；对于已登录用户，Codex 和 Work 会永久保留缓存，回到旧对话或隔几小时再继续都没有额外代价，并保证命中缓存。这条引用了 OpenAI Developers 关于 12 小时 prompt caching 的帖子。
posts.originalText:
Day 16/

You can now cache for 12h in the API and for logged in users across Codex & Work we keep cache forever and you don’t have any penalty for coming back to an old conversation or resuming after a few hours and are now guaranteed to hit the cache.
posts.quotedText:
You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API.

Persistent agents, like dots, reuse context throughout the day. 

You can keep shared instructions, tools, and context cached longer and pay the lower cached-input rate, even when requests are hours apart.
posts.titleEn: 12-hour caching in the API, cache kept forever in Codex & Work
posts.summaryEn: You can now cache for 12h in the API, and for logged-in users across Codex & Work the cache is kept forever, with no penalty for returning to an old conversation and guaranteed cache hits. Quotes OpenAI Developers' post on 12-hour prompt caching.

posts.title: Codex & Work 有效用量提升
posts.summary: 通过对 Codex & Work 的改进——让 subagents 之间复用 context、把 context 缓存得更久，以及改进 request routing 以提高 cache hits——提升实际能用到的用量。
posts.originalText:
Day 12/

We’ve made improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get. We achieved this by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and improved request routing that allows us to increase cache hits.
posts.titleEn: Higher effective usage for Codex & Work
posts.summaryEn: Improvements to Codex & Work increase effective usage by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and improved request routing that allows more cache hits.

posts.title: 大幅降低「Selected model is at capacity」出现频率
posts.summary: 已落地一系列改动并增加更多算力，以大幅降低扰人的「Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model」出现频率。即便偶尔还是出现，最终也应能自行继续，而不只是卡在那儿。如仍看到，可反馈以便排查。
posts.originalText:
Day 11/

We've landed a series of changes and more compute to very significantly decrease the occurrence of the disruptive "Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model". When it does happen, it should also eventually just continue by itself and not just block on it.

Let us know if you still see it out there in the wild and we'll take a look.
posts.titleEn: Much lower occurrence of “Selected model is at capacity”
posts.summaryEn: A series of changes and more compute landed to very significantly decrease the disruptive “Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model” prompt. When it still happens, it should eventually continue by itself instead of blocking. Report if you still see it in the wild.

posts.quotedText:
GPT-6 and Intelligent UI, now rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone.

Intelligent UI in ChatGPT delivers fast, interactive answers that make everyday questions more visual, complex topics easier to grasp, and interactive tools for your task available on the spot. https://t.co/XL2gDCPBwG
posts.titleEn: A new version of GPT-6 rolls out to all ChatGPT users
posts.summaryEn: A new version of GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out to all ChatGPT users, with more visual, interactive answers and on-the-spot interactive tools for the task. Tibo says many model and infrastructure improvements came together to scale it to 1.2B users.

posts.title: 四项更新之后，额度也重置了
posts.summary: Tibo 在当日投票后宣布使用额度重置已完成。原帖没有列出具体套餐范围或重置窗口。
posts.originalText: We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment. Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
posts.quotedText: Roundup of Day 2/ 2.1/ Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used. Also better for you. 2.2/ Simplified API for builders. 2.3/ Meeting notes integrated. 2.4/ Decisions API live for builders. Will use in the app to improve the experience.
posts.titleEn: Four updates, followed by a usage reset
posts.summaryEn: After the day’s community vote, Tibo confirmed that the usage reset had been processed. The post did not specify eligible plans or which usage windows were reset.

posts.title: Decisions API 开放公测
posts.summary: 近乎实时地选择模型、工具或操作。官方称，决策速度最高可达通过 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。
posts.originalText: Day 2.4/ Decisions API is live. We will use this ourselves to improve the experience for everyone in many fun ways. Realtime general classifier does open some great possibilities.
posts.quotedText: Let your app choose the right model, tool, or action in near real-time with Decisions API, now available to all developers in public beta. The Decisions API makes decisions up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API. https://t.co/zhgRVzJ3aP
posts.titleEn: Decisions API enters public beta
posts.summaryEn: Choose a model, tool or action in near real time. OpenAI says decisions can be up to 10× faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API.

posts.title: Meetings：会议结束，工作接着往前
posts.summary: 记录会议，结合已有工作生成个性化摘要与下一步事项，保存到 ChatGPT Space。macOS 桌面版 Pro / Business 已开放测试，Enterprise 即将支持。
posts.originalText:
Day 2.3/

Never worry about remembering what you were saying with that colleague. Just talk your heart out and build up the context to load up into codex to get it all done.
posts.titleEn: Meetings: turn conversations into next steps
posts.summaryEn: Record meetings and use existing work context to create personalized summaries and next steps, saved in ChatGPT Space. The macOS desktop beta is available for Pro and Business, with Enterprise support coming later.

posts.title: API 付费等级，五档变三档
posts.summary: 付费使用等级简化为 Build、Launch 和 Grow。最高等级 Grow 的累计 API 付款门槛从 1,000 美元降至 500 美元。
posts.originalText: Day 2.2/ OK this one is smaller, but we removed some friction for when building on the API. Happy building.
posts.quotedText: We’re making it easier to qualify for higher OpenAI API rate limits. Five paid usage tiers become three: Build, Launch, and Grow. You can qualify for Grow, our new highest tier, with $500 in total API payments—down from $1,000 for the previous highest tier. https://t.co/FGZ8mppEJa
posts.titleEn: Five paid API tiers become three
posts.summaryEn: Paid usage tiers are simplified to Build, Launch and Grow. Qualifying for Grow, the highest tier, now requires $500 in total API payments, down from $1,000.

posts.title: Auto-review 免费，不再占用套餐额度
posts.summary: 通过 ChatGPT 账号登录的用户可免费使用自动审核。权限菜单中的名称为「Approve for me」；Default permissions 本身不等同于开启自动审核。
posts.originalText: Day 2.1/ We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules. It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.
posts.quotedText: Day 1/ We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...). No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
posts.titleEn: Auto-review is free, with no plan usage deducted
posts.summaryEn: Auto-review is free for users signed in with a ChatGPT account. It appears as “Approve for me” in the permissions menu; Default permissions alone does not enable it.

posts.title: 默认速度提升约 50%
posts.summary: GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度提升约 50%，覆盖订阅内的产品，以及通过 ChatGPT 登录的合作伙伴。用户无需更改设置。
posts.originalText: Day 1/ We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...). No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
posts.quotedText: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
posts.titleEn: Default speed increased by about 50%
posts.summaryEn: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol are about 50% faster by default across subscription products and partners using Sign in with ChatGPT. No settings changes are needed.

posts.title: 28 天，每天一项改进，或一次额度重置
posts.summary: 未来 28 天，每天推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有帮助的明确改进，或者重置使用额度。
posts.originalText: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
posts.titleEn: 28 days: an improvement or a usage reset each day
posts.summaryEn: For the next 28 days, each day will bring a clear improvement relevant to most Codex / Work users, or a reset of usage allowances.

roundups.title: Day 2 · 四项更新，加一次额度重置
roundups.summary: Auto-review 免费、API 等级简化、Meetings 会议记录、Decisions API 公测；随后追加一次使用额度重置。
roundups.titleEn: Day 2 · Four updates and a usage reset
roundups.summaryEn: Free Auto-review, simplified API tiers, Meetings and the Decisions API public beta, followed by a usage reset.

roundups.title: Day 3 · 新版 GPT-6 进入 ChatGPT、储备重置，加场 Codex Cloud
roundups.summary: 新版 GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI 向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出；Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户达 4,000 万新高，所有付费账号载入一次储备重置；加场悄悄重新上线 Codex Cloud，可通过 Tailscale 连接 tailnet 资源。
roundups.titleEn: Day 3 · New GPT-6 in ChatGPT, a banked reset, and an encore for Codex Cloud
roundups.summaryEn: A new version of GPT-6 and Intelligent UI roll out to all ChatGPT users; Codex and ChatGPT Work hit 40M active users, and a banked reset is loaded into all paid accounts; an encore quietly re-ships Codex Cloud, which can now connect to tailnet resources via Tailscale.

roundups.title: Day 5 · Composer predictions 与 dots 手机创建
roundups.summary: 桌面端 Codex 的 Composer predictions 对 Pro 用户开放 beta，不消耗用量；dots 现可完全在 ChatGPT 手机 App（iOS / Android）里创建并使用。
roundups.titleEn: Day 5 · Composer predictions and mobile dots creation
roundups.summaryEn: Composer predictions in the Codex desktop app enter beta for Pro users without consuming usage; dots can now be created and used entirely in the ChatGPT mobile app on iOS and Android.

roundups.title: Day 8 · 额度重置，全球重置已完成
roundups.summary: 第 8 天宣布用量额度重置，并预告全球重置将在太平洋标准时间当日结束前落地；随后 Tibo 确认全球重置已经完成。
roundups.titleEn: Day 8 · Usage reset, then global reset done
roundups.summaryEn: Day 8 announced a usage reset and said the global reset would land by EOD PST; Tibo later confirmed it was done.

roundups.title: Day 10 · 额度重置，全球重置已完成
roundups.summary: 第 10 天宣布用量额度重置；随后 Tibo 确认重置已经完成。
roundups.titleEn: Day 10 · Usage reset, then global reset done
roundups.summaryEn: Day 10 announced a usage reset; Tibo later confirmed it was done.

roundups.title: Day 12 · Codex & Work 有效用量、GPT-6 Pro、Dots 主屏幕
roundups.summary: Codex & Work 通过 context 复用与缓存、request routing 提升有效用量；GPT-6 Pro / GPT-6 Astra Pro 响应更快并支持多 agent 并行；Dots 现已出现在 Home Screen。
roundups.titleEn: Day 12 · Higher Codex & Work usage, GPT-6 Pro, and Home Screen Dots
roundups.summaryEn: Codex & Work gain effective usage via context reuse, longer caching, and better request routing; GPT-6 Pro / GPT-6 Astra Pro get faster responses and multi-agent parallel work; Dots appear on the Home Screen.

roundups.title: Day 13 · 额度重置，全球重置已完成
roundups.summary: 第 13 天宣布用量额度重置；随后 Tibo 确认重置已经完成。
roundups.titleEn: Day 13 · Usage reset, then global reset done
roundups.summaryEn: Day 13 announced a usage reset; Tibo later confirmed it was done.

roundups.title: Day 15 · 我们完蛋了，随后改口并额度重置
roundups.summary: 第 15 天 Tibo 先发「我们完蛋了」，引用 OpenAI Developers 的 Codex 帖子；随后改口说还在继续开工，并宣布额度重置。
roundups.titleEn: Day 15 · We're cooked, then still cooking and reset
roundups.summaryEn: On Day 15 Tibo first posted "We're cooked", quoting an OpenAI Developers Codex post; he then said they're still cooking and announced a reset.

roundups.title: Day 18 · Decisions API GA、OpenResponses 与额度重置
roundups.summary: 第 18 天宣布 Decisions API 正式 GA，OpenResponses 加入 Linux Foundation，并提到性能改进与 Uber 全面押注 Codex 和 Work；同时宣布重置，预告明天太平洋标准时间上午 10 点前上线并带一个小 ship。
roundups.titleEn: Day 18 · Decisions API GA, OpenResponses, and a reset
roundups.summaryEn: Day 18 announced Decisions API GA, OpenResponses joining the Linux Foundation, performance improvements, and Uber going all-in on Codex & Work; also announced a reset landing tomorrow before 10am PST with a small ship.

roundups.title: Day 19 · dots / Codex & Work 小更新，Codex CLI 功能与用量
roundups.summary: dots 通话更快；Codex & Work 中途改 reasoning 不再使缓存失效；Codex CLI 新增 prompt presets、行内设置、企业 MCP 登录，并修复长会话与 Windows 企业代理；自 DevDay 以来 CLI 用量增长 2 倍。
roundups.titleEn: Day 19 · Small dots / Codex & Work updates, and Codex CLI growth
roundups.summaryEn: Faster dots calls; mid-conversation reasoning changes no longer bust Codex & Work cache; Codex CLI gains prompt presets, inline settings, enterprise MCP sign-in, long-session and Windows proxy fixes; CLI usage up 2X since DevDay.

roundups.title: Day 20 · 休息与重置，午夜前上线
roundups.summary: Tibo 宣布第 20 天休息与重置，并说明将于太平洋标准时间午夜前上线。
roundups.titleEn: Day 20 · Rest and reset, landing by midnight PST
roundups.summaryEn: Tibo announced a Day 20 rest and reset, and said it will land by midnight PST.
